claim: If Sensible doesn't find the OCR If Missing parameter's matched text in the document's embedded text, it OCRs every page.
sentence: If Sensible doesn't find the matched text in the document's embedded text, it OCRs every page. If it finds the text, it OCRs nothing. Use this parameter for documents with enough embedded text that Sensible doesn't OCR them by default, even when they contain text images such as a pasted screenshot. Choose text that's in every document of this type, but that can variably need OCR. If you specify an empty array, Sensible OCRs nothing. You can combine this parameter only with the Engine parameter.
